review_scope: Reviewers inspected candidate_harness and candidate_gateway; current component candidates contain the listed post-review changes and have not received a new independent D3 review.

findings: serve still uses the synthetic process adapter and process-local runtime map
strict and dynamic component paths do not prove the protected live action kernel
command failure recovery and tamper-evident replay remain incomplete
redacted export now has a sentinel test, but complete privacy evidence is still open
live service routes are not yet wired to owner-issued recovery authority
boot and lease issuance remain process-local and declarative
uncertain receipt admission, expiry and cross-process fencing need real-process evidence
the conformance driver previously discarded positive validation responses; it now asserts valid:true
the conformance driver now exercises and checks redacted export output
telemetry, full fault cases, exact cross-repository conformance and independent D3 review remain open

hierarchy.reason: review environments exposed no callable recursive delegation tool

post_review_changes: The served CLI now opens a SQLite-backed management store instead of the JSON fixture store.
The synthetic runtime persists its definition, snapshot and cancellation state and restores them after service restart.
Persisted run events carry integrity seals and offline replay rejects tampered events.
The conformance driver and delivery evidence now exercise positive validation and bounded redacted export.
The management status contract now exposes bounded typed recovery admission; the delivery process driver asserts safely-resumable capability without cursor/action fields.
The MCP Runtime-v2 mapper now optionally forwards a bounded workflow boot epoch to the gateway authority boundary.
The served SQLite store now explicitly enables WAL, synchronous=FULL and foreign-key pragmas, with direct management coverage.
Durable management command admission now serializes unresolved commands across independent SQLite connections and returns typed pending to the later caller.

Authoritative reconciliation now replaces provisional Accepted/Unknown transport evidence for the same operation, and direct Settled receipts are idempotent; explicitly built gateway/MCP/harness composition tests cover the recovery boundary.
acceptance: held; this wave is independent D1 review evidence and does not close the D3/G6 gate
